pages.tools.IslamicTools.seo.title: Islamic Tools — Quran, Prayer Times & More | Darasaone
pages.tools.IslamicTools.seo.description: Free Islamic tools for the ummah: read and listen to the Quran with translation, find accurate prayer times, locate the Qibla, and count your dhikr.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.title: Islamic Tools
pages.tools.IslamicTools.paragraph: Everything you need for your deen, in one place — the Quran with translation and recitation, prayer times, the Qibla direction, and more, all free.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.quran.title: The Holy Quran
pages.tools.IslamicTools.quran.descripti: Read all 114 surahs in Arabic with translation, listen to recitation, and search any verse.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.prayerTimes.des: Accurate Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha times for your city or current location.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.qibla.title: Qibla Finder
pages.tools.IslamicTools.qibla.descripti: Find the exact direction to the Kaaba from wherever you are.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.tasbih.title: Digital Tasbih
pages.tools.IslamicTools.tasbih.descript: A simple counter for dhikr — tasbih, tahmid, takbir, or any count you choose.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.ramadan.title: Ramadan Planner
pages.tools.IslamicTools.ramadan.descrip: Track your daily fasts and Taraweeh, set a Quran khatm goal, and log your Zakat and charity.
pages.tools.IslamicTools.attribution: Quran and prayer time data provided by Al Quran Cloud and Aladhan, free open Islamic data APIs.
